name: Darkwood Brook
description: A clear brook running fast over stones under the dark trees. Trout hang in the current, and the banks are soft enough to dig.

discovery.message: You hear running water, and find a brook chattering through a gap in the trees.

brook.text: The brook is clear and cold, quick over the stones. Speckled trout hold in the slack water behind the rocks, and the bank is soft, black earth.

leave.text: You leave the brook to its chattering.
